kaikki_vikisozluk.e: اِجْلَعَبَّ • (ijlaʕabba) IVq (non-past يَجْلَعِبُّ (yajlaʕibbu), verbal noun اِجْلِعْبَاب (ijliʕbāb))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From the root ج ل ع ب (j l ʕ b); possibly related to جَلْعَب (jalʕab, “malignant, malicious”).
s: ج ل ع ب (j l ʕ b)
g: to lie down on one's side and stretch oneself out
